# FG-REVIEW-0029

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_merge_request_that_is_not_merged_cannot_be_reverted` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: このマージリクエストは取り消せません（マージされていない、すでに取り消しのブランチがある、または取り消す変更が残っていません）。マージリクエストの状態を確かめてください。
- en: This merge request cannot be reverted (it is not merged, a revert branch already exists, or its change is no longer on the branch). Check the merge request's state.
- id: Merge request ini tidak dapat dibatalkan (belum di-merge, branch pembatalan sudah ada, atau perubahannya sudah tidak ada di branch). Periksa status merge request.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C10 (plan 04 M-4): `POST …/merge-requests/{iid}/revert` (or `gstn mr revert`, or the system's draft after the target's pipeline failed) could not build a revert merge request for a reason of the merge request itself: `reason=not_merged` (the merge request is open or closed), `no_applied_merge` (merged, but no applied merge attempt records what the merge moved — a merge request merged before M3 R4 or by another path), `target_missing` (the target branch is gone), `nothing_to_revert` (the target's tip no longer holds the change: it was reverted already), `branch_exists` (the revert branch `revert/mr-<iid>` exists: a revert was already opened — its merge request is the one with that source branch). Whether the caller may open a merge request and push the branch was decided before (FG-AUTH-0003, FG-GIT-0008 on a protected `revert/*`). Nothing was written: no commit is referenced, no branch, no merge request.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event `forge.review.revert_refused` carries `reason`, `project_id`, `merge_request_id`, `iid` and the request_id. For branch_exists: `gstn mr list --project <id> --state all` shows the merge request whose source branch is `revert/mr-<iid>`.

## 対処 (fix)

Nothing on the server. not_merged: a merge request that is not merged has nothing to revert (close it instead). branch_exists: use the revert merge request already opened, or delete the branch `revert/mr-<iid>` and revert again. nothing_to_revert: the change is gone already.
